Use case: stylized-concept. Edit target: the supplied Qiankun Danuoyi family VFX source sheet. Create candidate 2, fixing ONLY the hard straight vertical cutoffs at the LEFT ROOT of all four gold-ink swirls. Keep the amber-gold and umber ink wash palette, airy hollow clockwise open loops, four animation phases, 2 by 2 grid without visible dividers, pure white background, and original camera/layout. Requested landscape size 1536 x 1024, each local cell 768 x 512. No characters or palm; this is only energy material.
Critical repair: every root must have a soft ORGANIC irregular rounded silhouette, with several curved thin ink wisps that gradually dilute into pure white to the LEFT and above/below. A generous feathered fade at the left end, over at least 60 pixels, with no constant-x edge, no rectangle, no straight crop boundary, no flat ends, no hard seam, no visible masking box. The leftmost wisps end at different x positions. The center of each root near local (160,256) should contain translucent gold pigment and be connected continuously to the loop; fade occurs to its LEFT around x70..150. Root joins the loop without any gap. Do not draw a solid blob or a flare. Delicate semitransparent ink washes, separated curling strands, no solid outer contour. Keep all pigment and particles at least 48 pixels from each of the four cell edges. Center open vortex near local (435,256), rightmost near x665. Same fixed root in all cells, very small camera/position drift. Phases reading left-to-right top-to-bottom: gathering, fully visible peak, gently turning sustain, fading residue. This is an original visual interpretation of redirecting force, not a claim about novel-described light.
Avoid text, labels, numbers, watermarks, signature, borders, grid lines, symbols, yin-yang disk, human body, fingers, weapons, dragon, background scene, paper texture, gray shadows, lasers, fire, metallic objects, white highlight core, checkerboard. The entire background must be clean uniform white. Prioritize natural taper and translucent fading on every root over extra detail.

previous_candidate.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: white-background VFX source sprite sheet for a Chinese wuxia game, Qiankun Danuoyi shared family aura. This is original visual interpretation, not a quotation from the novel.
Make ONE landscape image, 1536 x 1024 requested, arranged as exactly 2 columns x 2 rows of four equal 768 x 512 cells, read left to right then top to bottom. No visible dividers. Pure uniform #FFFFFF background.
Each cell shows the SAME isolated amber-gold ink energy shape at four consecutive lifecycle phases: small gathering, full visible peak, gently turning sustain, fading residual. All four must retain a visible connected root, identical position and facing. No hands, humans, props or scene.
Shape: a short broad ribbon of translucent ochre-gold qi enters from a fixed root near local (150,256), then curls clockwise into an open hollow protective vortex centered near (425,256), front tip around x640. Wide root about 120 pixels tall, taper-free at the junction, with visible pigment through the root centre. The loop has brush-washed wisps, dry-brush gaps, transparent-looking airy interior and finely graded diluted golden ink; upper and lower curls convey redirecting force. It is a compact near-body aura, not a missile, laser, fireball, magic glyph or solid shield. Keep the core gold/umber, never white. Chinese ink-wash delicacy with restrained gold, uneven soft edges, calm circular flow and substantial empty space.
Framing: every painted pixel including dust must stay 48 pixels inside its own cell; fixed root and camera, modest shape changes, coherent animation, no cropping, no bridging cells. Broad bright-but-colored root smoothly joins the loop. Flat clean white background, no paper texture or shadows.
Avoid: text, numbers, labels, grids, borders, watermark, signature, yin-yang icon, bagua, black/white disk, weapons, dragons, fingers, metallic object, hard outline, neon red/blue, white highlights, checkerboard, glow touching edges.
